facts.fact: The source states that the Code du numerique (articles 262 to 270) creates a data protection authority whose duties include authorising or refusing cross-border transfers of personal data to third states, and that since 17 August 2024 a ministerial order gives those duties to ARPTIC because the authority itself is not yet set up; the source gives no date for the statement, so its published date 2025-01-01 is used.
